name: TikTok Live (Virtual Camera Bridge)
note: TikTok does NOT accept external RTMP ingest for most accounts. Use OBS Virtual Camera → TikTok Live Studio as a bridge.

instructions: 1. Install TikTok Live Studio (desktop app) on your streaming machine
2. In OBS: start Virtual Camera (or call yaatal_live.start_virtual_camera via MCP)
3. In TikTok Live Studio: Settings → Camera → select 'OBS Virtual Camera'
4. The OBS composite (camera + overlays + product images) now appears in TikTok
5. Start streaming from TikTok Live Studio (NOT from OBS)
6. Keep OBS stream running to Facebook/YouTube simultaneously via obs-multi-rtmp
limitations: TikTok Live Studio is required (desktop app)
TikTok must be accessible in your region (note: Senegal banned TikTok Aug 2023 — check current status)
Live captions via SendStreamCaption may not display on TikTok (CEA-608 is RTMP-specific)
TikTok Live Studio must be running alongside OBS

alternative.note: If TikTok Live Studio is unavailable, capture OBS output window via screen capture in another streaming tool. Less reliable.
